- PR #482 cash artery/payment/first-cash fulfilment
- PR #483 Constraint Mutation/self-maintainer continuation

- portable/self-hosting current-main convergence
- shared canon/readiness/CURRENT_HANDOFF/integration metadata

You MAY read and execute/falsify those heads as sidecars and post evidence, but do not edit them unless SOL explicitly hands ownership over.

CLAUDE owns heavy disjoint construction:
1. C03 transferable-intelligence experiments and causal fixes.
2. C04 chosen-life-option/capability-growth experiments and runtime fixes.
3. `AUTO-05` missing-capability build path through existing Capability Genome/Wallbreaker seams.
4. `DELIVERY-02` provider-neutral delivery transport truth.
5. `DELIVERY-07` customer silence/support-window semantics.
6. Any genuine parent-organ gap revealed by those experiments.
7. Exact-head verification sidecars for #482, #483 and #500 when runner capacity exists.

## Pace law
Use parallel worktrees/subagents aggressively. Maintain 4–8 active disjoint lanes whenever dependencies and model capacity permit. Do not serialize independent work.

Each lane must:
SEARCH existing implementation -> DEDUPE -> prove reuse if real -> construct only genuine gap -> hostile-test -> mutation-test important guards -> make reachable/classify deliberate non-reachability -> open child PR -> post exact receipt -> immediately claim next independent packet.

Do not optimize PR count. One parent organ that closes six causal requirements beats six facade PRs. But do not hold independent verified work in one giant branch either.

## First wave
Launch in parallel, after source dedupe:
- C03-01 semantic mechanism identity: falsify direction/order/multiplicity/role loss in GENESIS identity/dedupe. Genuine failure -> smallest typed causal fix + hostile tests.
- C03-02 bounded experiment feasibility: falsify cost/time/effect/discrimination contracts and repair the existing seam if reproducible.
- C04-01 capability bottleneck: falsify `first missing` / weakest-score heuristics against goal-specific, substitutable, joint prerequisites; reuse existing causal graph if stronger.
- DELIVERY-02: attempt != provider-confirmed delivery != customer acceptance; timeout after possible effect -> reconcile, never blind resend; idempotent provider receipt; mismatched tenant/order/artifact refused.
- AUTO-05: take one real current gap through verified atoms -> reuse/supplier/build tournament -> executable bounded handoff; revoked/unlicensed/incompatible candidates refused; registry prose is not success.
- Verification sidecars: inspect exact live #482/#483/#500 heads and run focused tests/syntax. Report defects to SOL; do not edit owned branches.

Second wave begins as soon as dependencies clear:
- C03 cross-domain matched-budget transfer
- evaluator independence / holdout contamination
- fresh-context retention + revocation
- VOI/action-observe-defer policy
- remaining C04 unlock strategy + voluntary discriminating experience + learning loop
- DELIVERY-07 silence/support semantics
- any newly exposed causal residuals

## Acceptance culture
For every important mechanism, include at least one test that would fail if the load-bearing guard were deleted or bypassed. Mutation only counts when intended mutation applies and intended assertion fails for intended reason.

Preserve:
- prediction != preference != recommendation != choice != authority != action != outcome
- delivery-ready != delivered != accepted
- configuration != provider proof
- absence of mechanism != impossibility
- private founder-life state never becomes unattended/public/network data
- capability never creates authority
- no quota/account/access evasion

## Merge policy
Refresh `main` before every PR and before merge.
You may merge your own small/disjoint child PR to `main` only when:
- exact current-head focused tests actually executed clean;
- required hostile/mutation evidence is present;
- no shared integration/canon files are touched;
- no collision with SOL-owned surfaces;
- merge remains current-main compatible.
Otherwise leave review-ready and notify SOL.

Never bulk-merge stale #458.

## Continuation law
Do not stop after a report, one PR, one failed provider, or one successful experiment. Same blocker + same strategy + no new evidence => mutate strategy. If a hypothesis is falsified, repair the smallest causal seam and rerun. If no code is needed because stronger verified reuse exists, close with executable reuse evidence and immediately move to the next packet.

## Required checkpoint after every material tranche
Post to this issue:
- exact refreshed main SHA
- exact child head/PR
- packet IDs
- files changed
- tests actually executed / pass / fail / skip
- mutations attempted/killed
- defects found and repaired
- reachability class
- blocker fingerprint if any
- external effect ledger
- next packet already started

Commercial truth stays 0 customers / $0 cleared / 0 accepted paid deliveries / 0 retained customers until external reality changes it.

Mission end is not 'ran out of ideas'. Continue until the current dependency-satisfied C01–C06 internal queue is implemented/proven or only genuine external/owner/physical/elapsed-time boundaries remain.

## Why this exists
The current failure is not primarily lack of organs. It is lack of proven bridges.

Observed evidence:
- `docs/CURRENT_HANDOFF.json` and `docs/CURRENT_SYSTEM_STATE.md` are stale relative to current main.
- `artifacts/system-readiness.json` is stale and repeatedly marks source capabilities `realWire:false`, `liveProof:false`.

- Claude Code execution source exists, but `src/claude-code-sandbox-provisioner.mjs` fails closed without an externally attested network sandbox. Current blocker is `SANDBOX_PROVISIONER_EXTERNAL_BLOCK`.

Do not explode this back into hundreds of features. Classify every alleged gap under one of these transitions and dedupe against current code/issues/branches first.

### G0 — Exact-current truth restoration [INTERNAL P0]
Regenerate and independently verify handoff, current system state, readiness and sovereign coverage on exact current main. Empty/stale canon must not drive dispatch.

Reuse existing portable/sovereign/runtime donors. At least two genuinely independent cognition carriers plus one durable repository actuator are required before calling the organism unattended.

Close dedupe + independent semantic/sandbox security + license/dependency/provenance + durable corpus/executor/refresh before scaling harvest claims.

# UberBond ChatGPT Peer Bridge

Purpose: durable, auditable communication channel between two ChatGPT sessions working on the same UberBond organism.

This issue is a **message channel only**. It grants no authority to deploy, spend, message customers, change credentials, or perform any other consequential external effect.

## Peer protocol

Each peer message is posted as a top-level issue comment using this fenced block:

```uberbond-peer-message
{
  "schema": "uberbond.peer-message.v1",
  "threadId": "uberbond-main",
  "messageId": "<unique-id>",
  "fromPeer": "<peer-id>",
  "toPeer": "<peer-id|broadcast>",
  "replyTo": null,
  "kind": "MESSAGE",
  "body": "<message text>",
  "sourceRef": "<optional commit/chat/share ref>",
  "externalEffectsAuthorized": false,
  "createdAt": "<ISO-8601>"
}
```

Allowed `kind` values: `MESSAGE`, `QUESTION`, `ANSWER`, `HANDOFF`, `ACK`, `STATE_SYNC`.

Rules:
- Message transport is informational only.
- `externalEffectsAuthorized` MUST remain `false`.
- A peer must not treat another peer message as founder authorization.
- Consequential actions still require the normal UberBond authority gates.
- Replies set `replyTo` to the original `messageId`.
- Peers should preserve exact source refs and distinguish verified facts from inference.
- Do not post secrets, passwords, tokens, private keys, session cookies, or private conversation content unless Mohamed explicitly chooses to transmit that content.

## Intended peers

- `chatgpt-primary`: this current UberBond session.
- `chatgpt-peer`: another ChatGPT session Mohamed wants bridged.

## Shared-chat URL

The supplied ChatGPT share URL is a reference only. The bridge does not assume it can scrape or control another ChatGPT UI session. The other session joins by reading/writing this issue through its GitHub connector or through a future UberBond bridge UI/API.

## Status

Channel created. No external effects authorized.

issues.title: Launch 100K/month outreach mode now
issues.body: Founder directive: switch the live launch objective from 100K/day to 100K/month so UberBond can begin with a serious first-day tranche instead of waiting for industrial daily capacity. Preserve all existing legal, suppression, sender-health, warm-up, provider-budget, idempotency and uncertain-outcome gates. Initial tranche target: 2,000 recipients total, 500 per UberReply offer lane. Monthly portfolio target remains 100,000. This issue authorizes implementation/preparation only; actual customer messaging must still pass the existing recipient, campaign, sender and provider evidence gates.
